units.source_text: 桐壶院在世时，特别重视这妹妹五公主，所以直到现在，

en.t: When the Kiritsubo Emperor was alive, he was especially fond of his younger sister, the Fifth Princess, and so even now,

units.source_text: 源氏内大臣还很亲近这姑母，常常有书信往来。

en.t: Genji, the Inner Minister, remained close to this aunt and often exchanged letters with her.

units.source_text: 五公主与槿姬分居正殿东西两侧。

en.t: The Fifth Princess and Lady Asagao lived separately on the east and west sides of the main hall.

units.source_text: 亲王逝世未久，邸内已有荒凉之感，光景异常岑寂。

en.t: The prince had not been dead long, yet the residence already felt desolate, and the scene was unusually lonely.

units.source_text: 五公主亲自接见源氏内大臣，和他对面谈话。

en.t: The Fifth Princess received Genji, the Inner Minister, in person and spoke with him face to face.

units.source_text: 她的样子十分衰老，常常咳嗽。

en.t: She looked very aged and coughed often.

units.source_text: 三公主，即已故太政大臣的夫人是她的姐姐，

en.t: The Third Princess, the wife of the late Grand Minister, was her elder sister,

units.source_text: 然而全无老相，至今还很清健。

en.t: yet she showed no sign of age at all and was still graceful and healthy.

units.source_text: 这五公主却和她姐姐不同，声音嘶嗄，样子有些龙钟了。

en.t: This Fifth Princess, unlike her sister, had a hoarse voice and looked somewhat decrepit.

units.source_text: 这也是境遇所使然。

en.t: This too was the result of her circumstances.

units.source_text: 她对源氏内大臣说：“桐壶院驾崩之后，

en.t: She said to Genji, the Inner Minister, "After the Kiritsubo Emperor passed away,

units.source_text: 我便觉万事意兴索然。

en.t: everything seemed empty and joyless to me.

units.source_text: 加之年事衰迈，平居每易堕泪。

en.t: Besides, as age has weakened me, I am moved to tears at the smallest things.

units.source_text: 如今这位兄长也舍我而去，

en.t: Now this elder brother too has left me behind,

units.source_text: 更觉得我这个人留在世间虽生犹死了。

en.t: and I feel all the more that I remain in the world alive in name only.

units.source_text: 幸而有你这个好侄儿前来慰问，

en.t: Fortunately, a good nephew like you has come to comfort me,

units.source_text: 使我忘记了一切痛苦。”

en.t: and that makes me forget all my sorrows."

units.source_text: 源氏内大臣觉得这个人老得厉害，

en.t: Genji, the Inner Minister, felt that she had aged terribly,

units.source_text: 便对她表示尊敬，答道：“父皇驾崩以后，

en.t: and showing her respect, he answered, "Since my imperial father passed away,

units.source_text: 世间的确万事全非了。

en.t: the world has indeed become utterly changed.

units.source_text: 前年侄儿又蒙无实之罪，流离他方。

en.t: The year before last, I, your nephew, was falsely accused and driven to wander in a distant place.

units.source_text: 不图又获赦免，重归朝廷，滥竽政务。

en.t: Unexpectedly, I was pardoned, returned to court, and now hold a place in government affairs beyond my worth.

units.source_text: 只是公事烦忙，少有暇晷。

en.t: But official duties are troublesome and pressing, leaving me little leisure.

units.source_text: 年来颇思常来请安，以便共话旧事，并多多请教。

en.t: For some time I have often wished to come pay my respects, talk over old days with you, and learn much from you.

units.source_text: 而未能如愿，实甚遗憾。”

en.t: Yet I have been unable to do as I wished, and I deeply regret it."

units.source_text: 五公主说：“啊呀呀，这世间真是变化多端啊！

en.t: The Fifth Princess said, "Ah, how full of change this world truly is!

units.source_text: 我阅尽沧桑，老而不死，自己常觉得此身可厌。

en.t: I have seen every turn of fortune, and growing old without dying, I often find this body of mine hateful.

units.source_text: 然而今天看到你重返京都，荣登高位，

en.t: Yet today, seeing you return to the capital and rise to such honor,

units.source_text: 又觉得当年我若只见你惨遭横祸，那时便轲而死，

en.t: I think that if, back then, I had only seen you suffer that cruel misfortune and had died at that time,

units.source_text: 才真是不幸呢！”

en.t: that would truly have been unfortunate!"

units.source_text: 她的声音发抖。

en.t: Her voice trembled.

units.source_text: 接着又说：“你长得真漂亮啊！

en.t: Then she went on, "How beautiful you have grown!

units.source_text: 你童年时候，我看见了你总是惊讶：

en.t: When you were a child, I was always astonished whenever I saw you:

units.source_text: 这世间怎么会生出这样光彩夺目的人来？

en.t: how could this world have produced someone so radiant?

units.source_text: 以后每次看到你，觉得越长越美，

en.t: After that, each time I saw you, I felt that the older you grew, the more beautiful you became,

units.source_text: 简直教人疑心神仙下凡，反而恐惧起来呢。

en.t: until one almost suspected that a divine being had descended to earth, and it became rather frightening.

units.source_text: 世人都说今上相貌与你十分肖似。

en.t: People all say that His Majesty's looks greatly resemble yours.

units.source_text: 但据我推想，无论如何也赶不上你吧。”

en.t: But in my judgment, no matter what, he cannot quite equal you."

units.source_text: 便滔滔不绝地讲下去。

en.t: So she went on talking without end.

units.source_text: 源氏内大臣想：哪有特地当着人面，极口赞誉美貌的呢。

en.t: Genji, the Inner Minister, thought: who goes out of the way to praise someone's beauty to his face so extravagantly?

units.source_text: 他觉得有趣，答道：“哪里的话！

en.t: Finding it amusing, he answered, "Not at all!

units.source_text: 侄儿年来流落风尘，身经苦患之后，衰老得多了。

en.t: In recent years, after wandering through hardship and suffering, I, your nephew, have aged a great deal.

units.source_text: 今上容姿之美，历代帝王无人能及，真是盖世无双。

en.t: As for the beauty of His Majesty's appearance, no emperor of any age could equal him; he is truly peerless.

units.source_text: 姑母这推想太奇怪了。”

en.t: Your judgment, Aunt, is far too strange."

units.source_text: 五公主说：“不管怎样，我但得常常看见你，这残命也会延长。

en.t: The Fifth Princess said, "In any case, if only I can see you often, this remaining life of mine will be prolonged.

units.source_text: 今天我老也忘记，忧患都消释，心情好畅快呵！”

en.t: Today I have even forgotten my old age; all my grief and worries have vanished, and my heart feels wonderfully light!"

units.source_text: 说过之后又哭起来，继续言道：“三姐真好福气，

en.t: After saying this she began to cry again and continued, "My third sister is truly fortunate,

units.source_text: 招了你这个女婿，常常好和你亲近，我真羡慕呵！

en.t: having taken you as her son-in-law and being able to be close to you often. I am so envious!

units.source_text: 这里已过的亲王，也常常懊悔不曾把女儿配给你呢。”

en.t: The late prince of this house also often regretted that he had not married his daughter to you."

units.source_text: 源氏内大臣觉得这句话很中听，答道：“若能如此，

en.t: Genji, the Inner Minister, found these words very pleasing and answered, "If that could have been so,

units.source_text: 大家常常亲近，我何等幸福呵！

en.t: and we could all have been close to one another, how happy I would have been!

units.source_text: 可惜他们都疏远我呀！”

en.t: Unfortunately, they all keep their distance from me!"

units.source_text: 他恨恨地说，透露出心事来了。

en.t: He spoke with resentment, letting his true feelings slip out.

units.source_text: 他望望槿姬所住的那一边，看见庭前草木虽已枯黄，却别有风趣。

en.t: He looked toward the side where Lady Asagao lived and saw that although the plants before the garden had already yellowed and withered, they had a special charm.

units.source_text: 想象槿姬闲眺这景色时的容姿，一定优美可爱。

en.t: Imagining Lady Asagao gazing idly at this scene, he thought her figure must be elegant and lovely.

units.source_text: 心痒难忍，便开言道：“侄儿今天前来拜访，

en.t: Unable to restrain his longing, he began, "Since I, your nephew, have come to visit today,

units.source_text: 理应乘便去那边望望槿姐，否则太不礼貌了。”

en.t: I ought to take the opportunity to go over there and call on Lady Asagao; otherwise it would be terribly discourteous."

units.source_text: 便告辞五公主，顺着廊檐走到那边去。

en.t: Then he took leave of the Fifth Princess and walked along the eaves of the corridor to the other side.
